title: The actual Kummer short complex with the shared Abelian zero structure
statement: For prime ell, a scheme T and Kummer data q [def-sp-tower-class-systems], construct the short complex with objects roots(ell,T), powerUnits(ell,T), units(T), arrows q.inclusion and q.power, and zero relation q.zero. Use the zero-morphism structure induced by the named towerAbelian instance. This actual short complex is short exact. Its arrows and objects are unchanged. Its positive derived boundary has the literal full-units and roots towers as endpoints, and is defined by this recorded short exact sequence.

proof.text: Construct the three-object short complex using the actual inclusion, power map and zero relation of q. The generic Abelian boundary API uses the same zero structure, which is definitionally equal to the direct one used by the Kummer record. Define the positive boundary by the standard single-complex connecting morphism of this short exact sequence, with its literal endpoints.
